name: HackerEarth
summary: HackerEarth Recruit offers developer screening assessments drawn from a bank of more than 25,000 questions. Its page describes advanced proctoring to ensure authenticity, and says coding tests are auto-graded and produce a leaderboard. The vendor publishes no price.

facts.text: The recruit page describes role-based developer screening assessments across more than 25,000 vetted questions.
The recruit page refers to advanced proctoring to ensure authenticity. The text read does not say whether webcam monitoring, plagiarism detection or tab-switch detection is included.
The recruit page says auto-graded coding tests are used, and that coding tests generate a leaderboard after every assessment.
HackerEarth's page offers an access free demo and demo requests. No price or currency is shown in the text read.
